subject: Post-demo: Integration & model routing follow-ups (SDK, auth, routing policies)
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>

Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, dev.patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-03-01T15:08:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: Integration & model routing follow-ups (SDK, auth, routing policies)

Hi Sarah — great to meet today, thanks for taking the demo with the team. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Summary of needs I heard
- Real-time decisioning in US regions with 50–200 TPS and p95 latency target ~150ms for short responses.
- Mixed workloads: generation for notifications, embeddings for semantic search/rerank, and a small reranker model for post-filtering.
- Security: customer-managed KMS, SSO-based provisioning, and audit logs for model calls.

Action items / next steps
1) Send integration guide + MAP for procurement (attached).
2) Tech follow-up to cover SDK setup, auth, and routing policies — propose Wed 3/3 11am PT. Can Lauren join to cover routing/fallbacks?
3) Quick bench: we'll propose model routing config prioritizing latency for critical paths and cost-optimized fallbacks for background jobs.

Technical notes (high level)
- SDK & auth: our SDK supports API keys and short-lived tokens via your IdP (SAML/OIDC). For private deployments you can also use service-account credentials with KMS integration.
- Routing/policies: we can configure routing policies that prefer low-latency replicas (pinned to us-west) for critical requests, with automatic fallback chains to cost-optimized quantized variants if latency SLOs are relaxed.
- Structured output & tool-calling: we support schema-constrained responses + tool calling for actions (e.g., create-transaction). We'll show examples in the tech call.
- Embeddings/reranker: recommend using dense embeddings for search with an intermediate FAISS index hosted in your VPC + a lightweight reranker (1–2B) as a low-latency post-filter.

Attachments: redwood-integration-guide.pdf, FintechCo-MAP.xlsx

Thanks — I’ll send a calendar invite for Wed 3/3 11am PT unless another time works.

Best,
Marcus
Marcus Lin | Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Marcus — useful recap, appreciate the clear next steps. A few notes from our side: 

- Wed 3/3 11am PT works for the tech deep-dive. I’ll invite our infra lead (cc’d procurement separately).
- For SSO: we prefer OIDC short-lived tokens rather than static API keys for prod. Can your SDK support automatic token refresh via our IdP?
- We’ll need a suggested routing policy doc that maps our endpoints to latency/cost priorities. Specifically: 
  * Transactional API (checkout flow) -> strict latency priority (p95 < 200ms)
  * Notifications/campaign copy -> cost-priority (batching + quantized models OK)
  * Search/rerank -> balance latency + quality (use embeddings + reranker).

Also, procurement asked for an example mutual action plan and a rough timeline (PO + integration + pilot). Please attach the MAP and estimated milestones.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Patel | CTO | FintechCo

On Mon, Mar 2, 2026 at 9:26 AM Sarah Patel <sarah.patel@fintechco.com> wrote:
> Thanks Marcus — useful recap, appreciate the clear next steps. A few notes from our side: 
> 
> - Wed 3/3 11am PT works for the tech deep-dive. I’ll invite our infra lead (cc’d procurement separately).
> - For SSO: we prefer OIDC short-lived tokens rather than static API keys for prod. Can your SDK support automatic token refresh via our IdP?
> - We’ll need a suggested routing policy doc that maps our endpoints to latency/cost priorities. Specifically: 
>   * Transactional API (checkout flow) -> strict latency priority (p95 < 200ms)
>   * Notifications/campaign copy -> cost-priority (batching + quantized models OK)
>   * Search/rerank -> balance latency + quality (use embeddings + reranker).

Thanks — noted. Quick answers below and what we’ll cover on Wed: 

1) SDK & Auth
- Yes: our SDK supports OIDC token exchange and short-lived tokens with automatic refresh. We also support service-account JWTs for server-to-server in private deployments and KMS integration for key rotation. I’ll have Dev run through sample code.

2) Routing & policy doc
- We’ll bring a draft routing policy that maps endpoints to: latency-first (pinned to low-latency replicas), cost-first (quantized variants with batching), and balanced routes (embeddings + reranker).
- Fallback chains: primary low-latency model -> intermediate quantized low-cost variant -> regional fallback (if capacity constrained) -> queue with best-effort retries for non-critical jobs.
- Region routing: can pin critical traffic to us-west replicas; failover to us-east/eu-central based on health and configured SLOs.

3) Structured output / tool calling
- Will demo structured-output schemas + safe tool calling for actions (we enforce schema validation and provide sandboxed tool adapters).

4) Embeddings + reranker
- Recommend dense-embedding pipeline with an index in your VPC. Reranker can be invoked as an optional second-stage call; we support conditional routing so reranker only runs when similarity score falls below a threshold.

Attachments: Attached MAP & integration guide.

Proposed pilot timeline (high-level)
- Week 0: Sign SOW / provisioning
- Week 1–2: Integration + SDK setup + auth config (test tokens)
- Week 3: Pilot dataset + embeddings index build
- Week 4: Pilot validation + SLA tuning -> go/no-go

Lauren will lead the routing policy portion on Wed. 

Best,
Marcus
